family: The single total family fixed in proof.md Section 0: the norm-one indicator family. At input length N, with t := 2^floor(log2(N)/3) and m := the largest odd m >= 1 with (t+1)m + t <= N (lambda := N - m - t - mt), the input is parsed as [Q-block: m bits, the coefficients of a monic degree-m Q in F_2[X]][R-block: t bits, a monic degree-t R in F_2[Y]][z-block: mt bits, the coefficients of z(X,Y)][leftover: lambda bits]; f_N(x) := 1 iff Q and R are irreducible over F_2 and z(X,Y)^e = 1 in F_2[X,Y]/(Q,R), where e = (2^(mt)-1)/(2^m-1) = 1 + 2^m + ... + 2^(m(t-1)) (gcd(m,t)=1 makes (Q,R) maximal, so the quotient is the field with 2^(mt) elements). The evaluator parses, runs the deterministic polynomial-time irreducibility test (Fact IRRED, field.md) on Q and R, and, if both pass, computes z^e by binary exponentiation with bivariate arithmetic reduced mod Q in X and mod R in Y: polynomial time at every length N. The language is L = {x : f_|x|(x) = 1}, in P, with empty NP witnesses.
theorem: For this one fixed total uniform polynomial-time family, hence one NP language with empty witnesses, at actual input length n=|x| in the full Li-Yang B2 model: liminf C_B2(f_n)/n >= 114062441973/25000000000 = 4.56249767892, by the complete McGuire-Schlesinger-Williams wire-graph/cutwidth route reproduced in proof.md with the rule-bound constant kappa_E = (3/(2*pi))*arccos((1+2*sqrt(2))/4) certified in checks.py; the rectangle property of the family is proved from the Kollar-Ronyai-Szabo product-system counting theorem, proved self-contained in krs.md.
